title: BioIVT: TNM classification gets a format check
description: Adds a warning (not a block: the check is soft unless marked strict) when a TNM classification does not look like T2N0M0, allowing the c, p, y, r, a prefixes, T0 to T4 with letters, Tis and TX, N0 to N3 with letters and NX, and M0, M1 and MX. Applies to the four TNM questions.
rationale: Real answers are TNM strings; a format check keeps them consistent without blocking unusual legacy values.

set.field.constraint_message: Enter the TNM classification, for example T2N0M0.

source: BioIVT Option C update; approved by Dan

history.note: Stage group and therapy outcome update.
